view.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall orange metal shelving units filled with cardboard boxes. An orange and black forklift is parked on the concrete floor near pallets. Blue plastic bins are visible to the right. The foreground shows part of a metal rack. Lighting is functional, casting soft shadows.

objects.label: orange and black forklift
objects.observation: An orange and black forklift stands on the concrete floor, positioned between shelves. Its forks are down, and it appears stationary. It is partially obscured by a metal rack in the foreground. No visible attachments or cargo.

objects.label: orange metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall orange metal shelves extend vertically, filled with stacked cardboard boxes. They are located behind the forklift and span much of the background. Some boxes have labels. The shelves appear freestanding and supported by vertical posts.

objects.label: blue plastic bin
objects.observation: A large blue plastic bin sits on the floor to the right side of the frame. It has a rectangular shape and appears to be empty. It is positioned next to another smaller blue bin and is partially blocked by the shelving unit.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Numerous cardboard boxes are stacked on the shelves and on wooden pallets on the floor. They vary in size and some have visible labels or markings. Boxes are arranged neatly on shelves and on pallets.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Wooden pallets are visible on the floor beneath the shelves and beside the blue bins. They support stacked boxes and appear weathered. One pallet is directly under the forklift’s base.

objects.label: metal rack
objects.observation: A portion of a metal rack is visible in the immediate foreground on the left. It appears to be a storage or display unit with vertical bars. It partially obscures the view of the forklift and shelves behind it.

<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s1-33078", "image_size": [640, 480], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
